title: Sewers of Nihilia: Slime Cube

zone.name: Sewers of Nihilia: Pool of Sludge

summary: Help Utandi recover his map by defeating a cube that divides into fragments.
overview: Help Utandi recover his map by defeating a cube that divides into fragments.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Keep add control ready when the large cube dies.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: With the pool task active, follow Utandi's dialogue through 'find it' to spawn the Slime Cube.
Killing the cube creates six fragments at its death position.
Recover the four map pieces and return them to Utandi for the task progression.

notes: Approval E297. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
